title: Prawn saganaki with tomatoes and feta
steps: Pour 200 ml hot salted water over the bulgur and leave covered for 10 minutes.
Chop the onion and garlic and sweat them in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and chilli flakes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Lay the prawns in the sauce, crumble the feta over and cook covered for 4–5 minutes until the prawns are pink.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the bulgur.
